hf:tencent/WePocketModel1.0-4B-MLX.description: Apple silicon build of `tencent/WePocketModel1.0-4B` for MLX. The weights are converted to the MLX layout and shipped with a self-contained runtime (`runtime/`), so the model runs on the Apple silicon GPU with no PyTorch, no `torchvision` and no video toolchain: tokenization uses `tokenizers`, and the Qwen3-VL image preprocessing (`smart_resize` + patchify) plus the MGVB visual bottleneck are re-implemented in `numpy`/`PIL`/MLX. One set of parameters still serves all three WePM capability families:
